fuente.titulo: Pope chooses theme for Lent Message 2027: 'Let us embrace fragility'

titular: Pope Leo picks 2027 Lent theme: 'Embrace fragility'
bajada: Message draws on his encyclical, challenging the idea of a limitless, self-made humanity
caption: Pope Leo XIV has announced the theme for his 2027 Lent Message: 'Let us embrace fragility.' The theme draws from his encyclical Magnifica humanitas and offers, in the Pope's words, 'an alternative to the illusion of a humanity that wants to recreate itself without limits.' Source: Vatican News, Nov 27, 2026.

ilustracion.descripcion: A quiet Vatican study with an open book and a lit candle on a wooden desk, warm light; a bishop's writing desk silhouette sits in the upper right third, left and center space open and calm.
